description: This file defines a Flutter widget named PopularProducts that displays a horizontal list of product cards representing popular products. It imports external components and models, and utilizes a ListView.builder to dynamically generate the list items based on demoPopularProducts data.

classes.name: PopularProducts
classes.description: A stateless widget that renders a section displaying popular products in a horizontal list.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the PopularProducts widget, including layout, styling, and list of product cards.
